validation.name: Shared contract manual inspection
validation.expected: Plan URLs and parsing stay within Basic/Pro/Ultimate with Basic fallback; one shared launch target is network-inert; countdown order is Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds and per-second changes are not live-announced.
evidence: Manual source inspection of implementation commit f32eb5521f0f3e261ff67ff17ca8bef7152a3876 confirmed Basic/Pro/Ultimate are the only plan domain values; plan URLs use stable basic/pro/ultimate query keys; absent or invalid query context resolves to Basic; LAUNCH is the single shared 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z target; countdown ticking uses local setInterval only, preserves days/hours/minutes/seconds order, contains no launch-date network request, and exposes no aria-live region.
